investigations.summary: repo.percona.com served pmm3-client experimental binary-amd64 Packages.gz files that did not match the 20:15 UTC Release index (1166/1167 vs 1165 bytes, 'Mirror sync in progress?') between 20:37 and 20:42 UTC, so apt failed on every Debian/Ubuntu branch; the repo is consistent now and apt update on noble and bookworm passes on a fresh VM, while arm64 and RPM lanes were green: an external repo publish race, not pmm-qa or PMM.

MongoDB Sharded Cluster Summary @post-upgrade failed because verifyAllPanelsHaveData reported only its last pass, and with 5s auto-refresh panels such as Top Hottest Collections alternate between data and empty results; reproduced on a CHAOS VM under load, fixed by counting a panel as missing only when every pass shows it empty.
